notes:
Full front-end redesign — Ascent 4.0 "Final Locked System".

Every screen now runs on one locked visual system instead of the old cool-slate/electric-blue theme: three-font stack (Calistoga headings, Inter body, JetBrains Mono data), warm stone-grey base with a terracotta primary accent and per-suite signature colors (GST sky, Tally plum, Audit ochre, Income Tax sage), no dark chrome anywhere in the app.

Login rebuilt as a single light page (no dark split panel). Home Hub rebuilt as a bento layout with tint-fill suite cards and real icon glyphs. The old flat dark 18-item sidebar is gone, replaced by a light tab strip scoped to whichever suite you're in. Splash screen and app icon updated to match. This is a visual-only release — GST/Tally/Audit engine logic is unchanged (full 68/68 backend test suite passing).
